description: This file implements a wrapper around the 'runc' container runtime, providing functionalities such as creating, executing commands, deleting, and querying the state of containers. It defines classes for container management, including configuration, state information, and execution control, and interacts with external files and processes.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates container runtime commands such as create, exec, delete, and state, using the 'runc' executable. Manages process execution, environment inheritance, and logging.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents the container's state information, including PID and status, parsed from JSON output.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including environment variables, loaded from a JSON file.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds process-specific configuration data such as environment variables.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Implements container management functions such as start, stop, status, and resource monitoring, using the 'runc' runtime.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container with optional parameters.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: InheritHostEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Inherits environment variables from host based on the container's config file.

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Stops and removes the container if it is running.
